card_words.name: CHIEF MARKETING OFFICER
card_words.pitch: Owns the brand and the story. Plans every campaign, measures what works, and keeps every product saying one clear thing.

say: A Chief Marketing Officer is the executive accountable for the brand and for growth. They set the marketing strategy, lead the marketing team, own how customers meet the brand across every channel, and measure what each campaign returns so the business grows on purpose.
